summary: NextNRG, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor, issuing a $2.0 million senior secured convertible note at a 12% interest rate and a maturity of October 24, 2026. The company received gross proceeds of approximately $1.8 million. The note converts at $0.75 per share and includes a 50% payment premium at maturity, along with restrictions on subsequent placements and a participation right for the investor. This is a financing arrangement, not a special-situation event; the filing details ordinary capital-raising mechanics with no strategic corporate action.
